_comment: Cluster access registry for 9to5-k8s-service-debug. No secrets: paths only. Regenerate with the skill's config refresh step.
helpers_install: sourced from ~/.bashrc; helper snapshot kept at config/helpers/rancher-log-alias.sh

not_covered.uat_prod: This kubeconfig exposes dev only (contexts are dev-buuchinhso*). uat/prod namespaces referenced by 9to5-env-config-sync are NOT reachable here. Ask the user for the uat/prod kubeconfig path instead of guessing.
not_covered.helm_templates: Deployed manifests come from ~/Documents/ots-env-custom/templates/helm plus per-env service-configs; the cluster is the source of truth for what is actually running.

helper_commands.kfind: kfind <app> <regex> [namespace] [context]  - follow logs filtered by pattern
helper_commands.ksql: ksql <app> [namespace] [context]  - follow logs, convert Hibernate show-sql + bind params into executable Oracle SQL
